g.text: are you ready to try again or are you going to keep playing "lets see what happens if I get amir stuck in an infinite loop lawwwwwl"

g.text: JUST BECAUSE I ACT LIKE A COMPUTER AND SPEND MOST OF MY TIME WITH COMPUTERS AND... UM...

g.title: j712085040
g.text: Hey, how goes? Did you audit the inventory yet?

g.title: j3146894681
g.text: never mind just don't do that again lol

g.title: j4272096892
g.text: No, I'm done with the text adventure. [End.]

g.title: j3806639378
g.text: Sorry, sorry. I had to see what would happen. I'll be good.

g.title: j1639941178
g.text: okaaaay but if you do it again there will NOT be a third time, for serious

g.title: j1227360837
g.text: I don't have time for games right now and you don't either. [End.]

g.title: j1763623518
g.text: "You wake to find yourself in a dark, dank, dungeon cell deep below ground. In the hall beyond the bars a guard snores. Sleep apnea? He should probably have that checked out. You don't remember much, but you know you need to get out."

g.title: j237169659
g.text: Wait... How did I get here?

g.title: j2899772872
g.text: "The open wall of the cell is blocked by old iron bars, and the door is secured with a rusty old lock. The guard's snoring grows louder, phlegmier."

g.title: j3363120732
g.text: it's a text based adventure! in KIM! play along.

g.title: j2000902216
g.text: "Try as you might, you still don't remember how you got here."

g.title: j1438912340
g.text: "You have no memory of how you got here."

g.title: j247751421
g.text: "In the dim torch light you make out a filthy bucket, a bench, and the barren bones of some long dead cell mate still chained to the wall."

g.title: j903568542
g.text: "The leg bone is dry as a..." umm

g.title: j4097482760
g.text: "A little voice in the back of your mind says 'hey, assclown, this is your last shot. You still can't remember how you got here. Quit dicking around.'"

g.title: j4199237624
g.text: "Dry as a thing that's been sitting there for decades. As you pick it up the shackles crash to the ground and break apart. Among the pieces is a jagged shard of metal."

g.title: j1191834030
g.text: "This stirs the guard. You hear him groan and grant as he stands and slowly walks into view."

g.title: j3470625888
g.text: "A foul stench wafting from the bucket instantly lets you know what it is used for."

g.title: j3485046431
g.text: "An ancient god has had enough of your shit. You have been struck by lightning. You are dead. The end."

g.title: j1577865397
g.text: That's not going to do me much good.

g.title: j2982554874
g.text: I wonder if this would make a good weapon?

g.title: j1762407775
g.text: Can I use that piece of metal to pick the lock?

g.title: j3925721733
g.text: "A massive Grineer, clad in armor, stands before you. He does not appreciate being woken from his slumber."

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be AmirRank6Convo3.
g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be AmirRank6Convo3.

g.title: j2111581902->Chat ends. Next chat will be AmirRank6Convo3.
j1057692107
g.text: "You think to yourself 'gee, if only I were a little more creative. If only I could think outside the box. A box I could maybe... pick... with... a piece of metal... or stab... with it...'"

g.title: j3247974330
g.text: "You examine the shard of metal. 'Not bad,' you think, 'this would stab as good as anything I've stabbed with before' as you pick it up."

g.title: j492209225
g.text: "You gingerly try and work the lock. Your tools are crude, but you instinctively know what you are doing- you are the master of unlocking."

g.title: j859393986
g.text: Hold up? Since when did you have Grineer in Fables & Frontiers?

g.title: j3312932305
g.text: "A little voice in the back of your mind says 'hey, assclown, this is your last shot. The bucket is still disgusting. Quit dicking around.'"

g.title: j1899756435
g.text: i thought you were game... roll with it

g.title: j2805628775
g.text: "The guard is having none of this. He pulls the keys from his waste and unlocks the cell gate and barges into the cell. Instinctively, you reach for your weapon but its not there, because you're a prisoner in a cell, and of course they've taken your weapon."

g.title: j920012242
g.text: since the moment i found out they were a thing

g.title: j1035956512
g.text: "At this point, the floor is getting slick with how many loogies the guard has spat onto the ground. Pick a different choice."

g.title: j1150634912
g.text: "The guard is unimpressed, he hoarks and spits into your cell and then turns to go back to his stool. Within minutes, the snoring rumbles through the dungeon once more."

g.title: j1062293890
g.text: what, would you prefer ogres or something

g.title: j2384296143
g.text: "After some struggle you maneuver the last tumbler into position. The mechanism rolls over with a too loud clank."

g.title: j1196435313
g.text: i'm trying to keep this fresh

g.title: j1872120731
g.text: "Before you know it, the guard is awake. He rushes to the door and you look up to see a massive Grineer towering over you. You reach for your weapon, but then you remember, you're a prisoner and you don't have weapons."

g.title: j1820798226
g.text: Took me by surprise, is all.

g.title: j228996494
g.text: Let's do this bare handed. Punch the bastard.

g.title: j3558693544
g.text: "The Grineer lunges at you. You jump to the side and drive the metal shank into his leathery neck."

g.title: j3794797550
g.text: "You wind up and land a furious haymaker punch right across his jaw."

g.title: j1007459050
g.text: "You dart across the cell and grab the bucket of filth, tossing it at him."

g.title: j3511929781
g.text: "As he chokes on his own blood, he gargles out his last words."

g.title: j135250367
g.text: "The guard doesn't so much as flinch."

g.title: j4217191268
g.text: "He is unharmed, unfazed, and unimpressed. But he may smell better."

g.title: j1432264183
g.text: lets get back to it, what'cha gonna do?

g.title: j1110963765
g.text: The Lotus can take care of herself.

g.title: j3719780844
g.text: "Everybody needs help sometimes. Now is your turn to help!"

g.title: j334115433
g.text: i'll see you in the next chapter... right after i write it

g.title: j3710030546
g.text: "There's nowhere to go. He grabs your head and smashes it against the wall. You die a gruesome and ignoble death."

g.title: j870922045
g.text: "Do you want to restart from checkpoint?"

g.title: j419017370
g.text: Amir. This has been fun, but I have work to do and you have inventory to audit. [End.]

g.title: j1097146040
g.text: you know i'm just going to resurrect you in the next chapter

g.text: sooooo in the interest of... getting out of here at some time today...

g.title: j2567515408
g.text: "The Grineer lunges at you. He stops and clutches his chest. Blinking in surprise, he seems to suffer an abrupt heart attack."

g.title: j1505969643
g.text: "As he dies through no action of yours, he growls out his last words."

g.title: j4282977001
g.text: The Lotus can take care of herself.

g.text: everybody needs a carry now and then!!
